newsitem.title: UK: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to March 16.
newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to March 16.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - TO March 16
The following is a one-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.
TUESDAY, MARCH 11

LONDON - Active! Why Advertisers Must Unleash their Latent Power, annual policy conference of the Incorporated Society of British Advertisers. President's Address by Ian Ramsay, chairman of CPC; lunchtime address by Channel 5 chief executive David Elstein. Marriott Hotel, Grosvenor Square. Contact: (44) 171 499 7502
LONDON - London International Direct Marketing Fair, Wembley Conference and Exhibition Centre. (first day of three-day conference)
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 12

PARIS - Hearings on French communications bill. Hearings presentations by: Xavier Gouyou-Beauchamps, head of France-Television; Patrick Le Lay, head of TF1 and TPS, and Herve Bourges, president of French industry regulator Conseil Superieur de l'Audiovisuel
LONDON - London International Direct Marketing Fair (second day of three-day conference)
LONDON - The Television Show, The Business Design Centre, Islington. 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Contact: (44) 181 240 5050 (first day of three-day conference)
LONDON - Reed Elsevier releases full-year 1996 results
LONDON - Midland Independent Newspapers releases full-year 1996 results
LONDON - Telewest releases full-year 1996 results.
THURSDAY, MARCH 13
LONDON - London International Direct Marketing Fair (final day of three-day conference)
LONDON - The Television Show, The Business Design Centre, Islington. (second day of three-day conference)
LONDON - Cordiant Plc releases 1996 full-year results
PARIS - Carat releases figures for French television advertising market.
LONDON - Mirror Group Plc releases full-year 1996 results
FRIDAY, MARCH 14
LONDON - The Television Show, The Business Design Centre, Islington. (final day of three day conference)
LONDON - United News & Media Plc releases 1996 full year results.
SATURDAY, MARCH 15
LONDON - Follow the Mouse multimedia exhibition for families and children. Olympia National Hall. Contact: (44) 01203 426 454 (first day of two-day exhibition)
SUNDAY, MARCH 16
LONDON - London International Book Fair '97, Olympia Grand and National Halls. Contact: (44) 01203 426 454 (first day of three-fair exhibition)
LONDON - Follow the Mouse multimedia exhibition for families and children. Olympia National Hall. (second day of two-day exhibition)
